description.zh: 应用镜像ID，可从无影云应用控制台的镜像管理页面获取。
description.en: The application image ID. You can obtain this ID from the Image Management page in the WUYING Cloud Application console.

description.zh: 交付组所属的地域ID。关于支持的地域详情，请参见[使用限制](~~426036~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the delivery group. For more information about supported regions, see [Limits](~~426036~~).

descriptions.zh:
><warning>开始更新镜像后，终端用户访问云应用的会话将会断开，请谨慎操作，以免造成终端用户的数据丢失。></warning>

> 更新发布成功后，一般需要等待2分钟左右，变更才会在终端生效。
descriptions.en:
><warning>After the image update starts, sessions of end users who are accessing cloud applications will be disconnected. Proceed with caution to avoid data loss for end users.></warning>

> After the update is published, changes typically take about 2 minutes to take effect on the end user side.
